title: Street performers with amplifiers on Rynek
description: Every evening there are buskers on Rynek Główny with huge speakers right under our windows. It goes on well past 10pm and you can hear it through closed windows.

title: Delivery vans blocking ul. Grodzka
description: Delivery vans park on ul. Grodzka well after the allowed morning window. Pedestrians and rickshaws have to squeeze around them in the middle of the street.

title: Loud bars on Plac Nowy until 3am
description: The bars around Plac Nowy play music and crowds shout outside until 3am on weekends. Residents of the surrounding tenement houses cannot sleep at all.

title: Late-night music near the Okrąglak kiosks
description: Someone sets up a speaker next to the zapiekanka windows at the Okrąglak on Plac Nowy almost every night. The bass is still going at 2am.

title: Abandoned rental scooters on ul. Estery
description: A pile of rental scooters has been lying on the pavement at ul. Estery for days. Nobody from the operators has come to collect them.

title: Dark path through Park Daszyńskiego
description: The main path across Park Daszyńskiego towards ul. Fabryczna has no working lights. Many people walk there from Galeria Kazimierz in the evening.

title: Unsafe underpass at Rondo Mogilskie
description: The pedestrian underpass at Rondo Mogilskie is poorly lit and people often drink there at night. I avoid it after dark and walk the long way around.

title: Dark path through Park Krakowski
description: Half of the lamps along the main alley in Park Krakowski don't work. It feels unsafe walking home from ul. Karmelicka in the evening.

title: Lamps out around the pond in Park Krakowski
description: The lights around the pond in Park Krakowski have been off for two weeks. Joggers and dog walkers can barely see the path.

title: Deep potholes on ul. Bronowicka
description: There are several deep potholes on ul. Bronowicka between ul. Rydla and the tram stop. Cyclists have to swerve into traffic to avoid them.

title: No crosswalk at bus stop on ul. Armii Krajowej
description: People get off the bus on ul. Armii Krajowej and run across four lanes because the nearest crossing is far away. Someone will get hurt there.

title: Illegal dumping by Bronowice Małe tram loop
description: Someone dumped old furniture and building rubble in the bushes next to the Bronowice Małe tram loop. The pile keeps growing every week.

title: Ambulance access blocked on ul. Prądnicka
description: Cars park along ul. Prądnicka by Szpital im. Jana Pawła II and block the access lane for ambulances. I watched an ambulance wait several minutes to get in.
